name: json2dir-dafny
description: Dafny compiled to C# (.NET 8): verified parser, UTF-8 and name validation, thin C# I/O externs
build:
export DOTNET_ROOT={runtimes}/dotnet-8.0.425 PATH={runtimes}/dotnet-8.0.425:$PATH NUGET_PACKAGES={runtimes}/dafny-4.11.0/nuget-packages DOTNET_CLI_HOME={runtimes}/dafny-4.11.0/home DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE=1
{runtimes}/dafny-4.11.0/dafny/dafny build --target:cs {src}/json2dir.dfy {src}/Externs.cs -o {src}/out/json2dir
